# Executive Leadership

Our global leadership is a key factor in our continued success. Learn more about the members of our global executive leadership team that shape the company’s vision.

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/Adaire_Fox_Martin.png)

## Adaire Fox-Martin

CEO and President, Equinix

Adaire Fox-Martin is CEO and President of Equinix, the world’s largest data center company.  In this role, she is responsible for all facets of strategy, operations, and execution in the organization, including the construction of data-center capacity, the development of solutions and services to simplify infrastructure provisioning, and the continual improvement in the value and experience customers and partners realize when engaging with Equinix.

Appointed in 2024, Adaire leads the company’s 13,700 employees in the innovation, sale, operation, and administration of the industry’s most expansive data-center footprint: 280 data centers in 77 markets serving more than 10,500 customers. Together with the Equinix Executive Leadership Team, she has defined and executed a strategy reinforcing Equinix’s core retail colocation leadership, while also making the most of the multi-year infrastructure investment cycle supporting the advancement of artificial intelligence.

Adaire has also been a member of the Equinix Board of Directors since 2020, a role she continues as CEO and President.

Adaire has established a distinguished 25-year track record in the technology sector. She was previously President of Go-to-Market for Google Cloud and Head of Google Ireland. In this role, she led Google Cloud's go-to-market teams globally, encompassing sales, professional services, partner ecosystem, and customer success. Prior to Google, she had board and executive-level positions at SAP, as well as executive leadership roles at Oracle.

Adaire is a passionate advocate of social entrepreneurship and social impact. She was Global Executive Sponsor for Social Enterprise at Google and currently serves on the Board of the Equinix Foundation, whose purpose is to enable an accessible, sustainable, and interconnected digital future for more people.

Adaire is a graduate of Trinity College in Dublin, Ireland.

## Raouf Abdel

Executive Vice President, Global Operations

Raouf Abdel, EVP, Global Operations, oversees Design, Construction, Procurement, Energy and IBX Operations for Equinix’s world-class data centers and interconnection platform. Raouf has led the Operations team to become the globalized organization it is today, providing consistent, high-quality and reliable services with integrity, and delivering exceptional frontline experiences to customers around the world. He joined the company in 2012 and previously served as Regional Operating Chief, Americas.

Raouf brings more than three decades of experience in the data center, telecom and construction industries. Prior to Equinix he was President & CEO of OpTerra Energy Group, providing strategic and operational leadership for the company.

Prior to OpTerra, Raouf served as President of the Business Markets Group with Level 3 Communications and was previously Vice President of Network Development with MFS Communications.

Raouf is on the Chief Operating Officers Council. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Temple University in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/chris-audie.png)

## Chris Audie

Chief Product Officer

As Chief Product Officer, Chris Audie leads Equinix's global product strategy and execution across the company's infrastructure, interconnection, and network offerings, as well as technology partnerships and ecosystems. He joined Equinix in July 2026.

Chris is an enterprise software executive with a track record of building infrastructure, automation, security, AI, and platform technologies used by developers and global organizations to run their most critical systems.

Prior to joining Equinix, Chris served as Chief Product and Technology Officer for Infrastructure and AI at HashiCorp, where he led product, design, and engineering across infrastructure as code, workload orchestration, service networking, and AI technologies. Before joining HashiCorp, Chris held product leadership roles at Google Cloud, SAP, and Concur.

Chris earned an MBA from Duke University, where he was a Fuqua Scholar, and a Bachelor of Science in Engineering from Purdue University.

Read More

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/nicole-collins.png)

## Nicole Collins

EVP of Business Operations

Nicole Collins is the Executive Vice President of Business Operations at Equinix. She joined the company in 2021 and leads the strategic execution of Equinix’s enterprise-wide operating model, overseeing performance standards that drive operational excellence and long-term growth.

Nicole plays a critical role in aligning the company’s operational vision with its business objectives, ensuring innovation, customer-centricity, and efficiency across the organization. Prior to her current role, Nicole served as Equinix’s Chief Transformation Officer, where she spearheaded transformative initiatives that accelerated sales and advanced the company’s Go-to-Market strategy.

With nearly two decades of experience at VMware and Dell, Nicole held senior executive positions focused on sales leadership, integration strategy, and sales and channel transformation. Her expertise in these areas was instrumental in driving growth and strategic planning.

Throughout her career, Nicole has been a dedicated advocate for diversity, inclusion, and belonging. At Equinix, she serves as the Executive Sponsor for WomenConnect, an employee resource group that empowers women within the organization. Her commitment to creating inclusive workplaces has made her a respected mentor and leader across the tech industry.

Read More

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/olivier-leonetti.png)

## Olivier Leonetti

Chief Financial Officer

As Chief Financial Officer, Olivier Leonetti partners with the Equinix leadership team to advance the company’s strategic priorities, drive profitable business growth and create shareholder value. He leads Equinix’s global finance function, overseeing accounting, business assurance, financial planning and analysis, investor relations, payroll and stock services, corporate real estate, tax and treasury. He joined Equinix in March 2026.

Olivier is a distinguished executive who served as CFO of four publicly traded companies prior to Equinix and has deep experience in the technology and infrastructure sectors. Most recently, he served as CFO of Eaton, a global intelligent power management company. He previously served as CFO of Johnson Controls and, prior to that, was CFO at Zebra Technologies and Western Digital. Earlier in his career, he held senior executive positions at Dell and Amgen.

Olivier holds a Master’s degree from Aix-Marseille University in Economics and Finance in Marseille, France and an MBA from Grenoble IAE in Saint-Martin-d’Hères, France.

Read More

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/harmeen-mehta.png)

## Harmeen Mehta

Chief Digital and Innovation Officer

Harmeen Mehta serves as Chief Digital and Innovation Officer at Equinix. She joined the company in 2025 and drives the company's digital transformation and innovation strategy, leveraging forward-looking technologies to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and innovative business models.

Harmeen is an AI-first transformation leader with 28 years of experience in large-scale digital transformations and business innovation. She has a global resume, having lived in 11 countries and worked in 40 across six continents.

Prior to Equinix, Harmeen held senior roles at BT Group, Bharti Airtel Limited, BBVA, Bank of America Merrill Lynch, and HSBC. She is a recognized digital transformation and AI leader, and she was awarded the 2018 MIT Sloan CIO Leadership Award and TMForum Global CIO of the Year award. Additionally, she has been acknowledged by Economic Times as a top woman in telecom and tech globally and received the Women of the Decade in Innovation & Leadership award from the Women Economic Forum.

She is passionate about creating inclusive workplaces and has led numerous initiatives to promote diversity in the tech industry. As an active member of the UK-India Global Forum, she has led several initiatives to facilitate engagement to advance strategic partnerships and investment flows within the UK-India corridor and beyond. She is an advisor with Sekura and also serves on the Lloyds Banking Group, and TM Forum boards.

Read More

## Brandi Galvin Morandi

Chief People Officer

As Chief People Officer, Brandi Galvin Morandi oversees all aspects of our People strategy including organizational effectiveness, talent acquisition, performance, compensation and benefits. Brandi and her global HR organization serve as stewards for the Equinix culture and are focused on building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where employees thrive. She joined Equinix in 2003.

During Brandi’s tenure, Equinix has been named as one of Fortune’s “Most Admired Companies” and as Glassdoor’s top 100 “Best Places to Work.”

Most recently, Brandi was Chief Legal and Human Resources Officer. She has also served as Equinix’s General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. Before joining Equinix, Brandi practiced corporate securities law and held various positions in the field of public relations.

She holds a Bachelor of Arts in International Relations and Journalism from the University of Southern California and a Juris Doctorate from the University of California, Hastings College of the Law. Brandi also serves as a Board Member of the Equinix Foundation.

Read More

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/bruce-owen-global.png)

## Bruce Owen

EVP, Global Markets

As EVP, Global Markets, Bruce oversees the company's regions. He is responsible for driving enterprise-wide business performance and strategic growth through capital strategy, portfolio, and operating decisions in the regions. He is responsible for ensuring strong regional input into enterprise strategy and decision making, and he partners closely with regional leaders to align global priorities with local market needs.

Bruce joined Equinix in 2010 and has held multiple leadership positions in both EMEA and the US during his tenure, including President of EMEA, Managing Director of the UK, Chief of Staff in CEO Office as well senior roles in Finance and the People team. He also previously held the position of President of the Equinix Foundation.

Bruce is a chartered accountant and began his career with KPMG in South Africa.

Read more

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/shane-paladin.png)

## Shane Paladin

Chief Customer and Revenue Officer

Shane Paladin joined Equinix in July 2025 as Chief Customer and Revenue Officer (CCRO). He is responsible for the company’s entire go-to-market strategy and approach, including sales, marketing, revenue operations, and customer care and experience.

Prior to Equinix, Shane was the CEO of Siteimprove, a global provider of cloud-based website governance and optimization tools. He previously spent more than a decade at SAP in a variety of senior roles including EVP and Global Head of Services Sales and COO of Greater China. Most recently he led the development and execution of strategy, customer success and growth initiatives for the company’s global services business as President, Services.

Shane also served in leadership positions at SignalFX, Ayasdi and FocusFrame, in advisory or board roles at Nordic Capital, SmartRent, and Board International and he started his professional career in the United States Army.

Shane earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration and Management Information Systems from Saint Leo University and a Master’s in Strategy and Innovation from the University of Oxford.

Read More

![profile image](https://www.equinix.com/content/dam/eqxcorp/en_us/images/company/leadership/kurt-pletcher.png)

## Kurt Pletcher

Chief Legal Officer

Kurt Pletcher is Chief Legal Officer and leads Equinix’s global legal strategy and day-to-day legal operations. Together with his team, Kurt ensures we have policies and practices that propel business growth, enhance the customer experience, and are compliant with laws in the countries where Equinix operates, all while championing integrity and the highest level of ethical standards. Kurt joined Equinix in 2001.

During his tenure, Kurt has held leadership roles across a variety of global legal departments as part of Equinix’s Customer & Revenue Office and served as the VP of Legal, Americas focused on M&A, real estate, and employment.

Prior to joining Equinix, Kurt held roles in the Employment Law Group at Paul, Hastings, Janofsky & Walker LLP and the Technology Group at Gunderson Dettmer Stough Villeneuve Franklin & Hachigian, LLP in Menlo Park, California.

As a strong ally of the LGBTQ+ community, Kurt serves as the Executive Sponsor for PrideConnect, Equinix’s employee connection network committed to ensuring Equinix is a leading employer for this community.

Kurt holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science from the University of California, Riverside, and a Juris Doctorate from the George Washington University Law School in Washington, D.C.
